scope: Stage optimization; separate from release acceptance
entry_condition: Final candidate passes TRAIN repair selection, all known200/public116 gates and own-weight formal performance. Freeze candidate and configuration before new sources are collected.
source_rules: Named new sources with permission/license, attribution and traceable original content. Audit all source/reference/context/glossary/ambiguity before any model output is inspected.
Both directions, alternate contexts and near paraphrases stay in one source family.
Isolate all historic TRAIN, DEV and viewed evaluation source families using exact and approximate retrieval plus source-grounded manual resolutions.
No DEV answers, original DEV errors or near rewrites may be used to author TRAIN or independent confirmation.
If confirmation informs further tuning it becomes regression; a different new source set is required for final confirmation.
release_policy: data/release_acceptance_policy.md still requires fresh600 rows/300 groups and all stricter release gates.
method_claim: Concrete candidate engineering result only without valuable matched methods and at least3 seeds.
